svg.title: Recent activity
svg.desc: Recent public GitHub activity: pushed NEXUS-PAPERS (“Add REA reverse-engineering research: Hey Siri teardown + Hitodama”), Nov 6; pushed macos (“Run on macos-latest; GitHub retired the macos-14 image”), Nov 6; merged PR mahayuddh (“Prove a linked handle is yours; only the server says verified”), Nov 5; merged PR mahayuddh (“Drop PostHog while error tracking is off”), Nov 4; merged PR mahayuddh (“PostHog error tracking (browser, boundaries, server)”), Nov 3; merged PR mahayuddh (“Links from other sites returned 403 Cross-origin request rejected”), Nov 2.
